expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.emptyBody: Add travel, materials and other costs, with a photo of the receipt, to bill them to a client.
expenses.unitsHint: The amount is calculated from the category's price per unit.
expenses.billableHint: Bill this expense to the client.
expenses.projectNotBillable: This project isn't billable, so the expense won't be billed.
expenses.receiptHint: A photo or PDF, up to 25 MB.
expenses.receiptWillBeRemoved: The receipt will be removed when you save.
expenses.receiptFailed: The expense was saved, but the receipt wasn't attached: {{message}} Choose the file again and save.
expenses.deleteBody: The expense and its receipt are deleted. This can't be undone. A record of the expense, without the receipt, stays in the account's audit log.
expenses.noAssignments: You're not on any projects yet. Ask a manager to add you to a project, then add expenses to it.
expenses.noCategories: There are no expense categories yet. Ask an admin to add some in Settings.
expenses.firstCategory: Every expense has a category, such as Travel or Materials. Add your first category, then the expense.
expenses.moreCategoryOptions: More options, such as a price per unit for mileage, are in Settings.
